statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service was coded as CPT 93229.
The diagnoses submitted were R00.2 and R42.
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50.
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines.
The clinical criteria for this specific diagnostic modality were not met.
